full_name: Nancy L. Rose | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2021–2022 Social Sciences Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Nancy L. Rose is the Charles P. Kindleberger Professor of Applied Economics and a former head of the Department of Economics at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). Her recent research on foundations for more effective antitrust enforcement builds on her experience as deputy assistant attorney general in the US Department of Justice’s Antitrust Division.
